name: vogue-soa-fashion-club
description: Official Web Platform for VOGUE – SOA Fashion Club (SOA University, Bhubaneswar)

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix server run prisma:push && npm --prefix server run prisma:seed && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build

author: GDGoC ITER
